name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: a prompt enhancer, a visual design-direction picker, and an assumption tracker.

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Rewrites a vague draft in the prompt box using the project's instructions, skills and conversation; Send submits it.

plugins.name: design-picker
plugins.description: Draws design-direction questions from AskUserQuestion as visual mockups to pick from; other questions untouched.

plugins.name: assumption-tracker
plugins.description: Claude records each assumption it makes; review them in a side pane, mark them right or wrong, and the verdicts go back to Claude.
